instruction.name: xvmaddwev.d.w
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned signed 32-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding signed 32-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 64-bit, and add the product to the 64-bit elements in `a`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvmaddwev.d.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvmaddwev.d.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvmaddwev.d.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvmaddwev.d.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvmaddwev.d.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvmaddwev.d.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvmaddwev.d.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvmaddwev.d.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
